annotations.title: Start, Stop or Restart VPS App

description: Start, stop or restart an installed One-Click App on a VPS. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the VPS: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_vservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.
